{{Top|leg}}
An '''identification plate''', also known as an '''ID plate''', were worn by all [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] personnel, usually on their chest opposite their rank insignia. The plates were magnetically encoded with the wearer's rank and security clearance which allowed them access to restricted areas via [[security door scanner]]s. If personnel without proper clearance attempted to pass through a security door, access was denied and, in some cases, an alarm was sounded.
